_comment: Recorded agent behaviour, used when GROQ_API_KEY / SERPAPI_KEY are absent.
The code path is identical to live operation: the same aggregate() function
consumes these samples and applies the same escalation policy. Only the two
The Garner record reproduces a real inconsistency observed in the original
n8n workflow, where the same player and the same input returned SUSPENDED on
one run and INJURED on the next, sixty seconds apart. It is included so the
disagreement-escalation path is exercised in the demo rather than asserted.

Garner._case: Unstable verdict. Three samples, three different statuses. Escalates on disagreement.
